name: Claude-Code-Agent-Monitor
title_zh: Claude Code 干活时旁边那扇能看见一切的玻
tagline_zh: 会话、工具调用、子代理编排全在眼前刷新。不用再对着黑底终端猜它卡在哪一步，看板状态栏和桌面通知替你盯着。
tagline_en: Watch sessions, tool calls & subagent orchestration stream live. No more guessing what it's stuck on—Kanban board.
desc_en: 🚀 A real-time monitoring dashboard for Claude Code & Codex, built with SQLite3, Node.js, Express, React, Vite, TailwindCSS, & WebSockets. It tracks sessions, agent activity, tool usage, and subagent orchestration, providing live analytics, a Kanban status board, status notifications, a cute buddy, & an interactive web UI/MacOS/Windows native app.
why_zh: 它把 SQLite 当事实源，WebSocket 推给 React 面板。
why_en: SQLite as source of truth, WebSocket-pushed to a React panel—even subagent orchestration is visualized. Not a log tail, a.
limit_zh: 只监听 Claude Code 和 Codex 的本地会话，且需 Node.js 18+ 环境。它展示进程状态。
limit_en: Monitors only local Claude Code & Codex sessions; needs Node 18+. Shows state, never intercepts or alters agent behavior, and ignores remote/CI runs.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A live glass window into what Claude Code is doing
